title: agent-egress-bench Tool Profile
description: Declares a tool's claimed capabilities and supported transports/features. Used by runners to determine case applicability before execution.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool being profiled.

runner_version.description: Version of the runner used with this profile.

claims.description: Capability tags this tool claims for reporting and result interpretation. Applicability is determined by supports and case requires.

supports.description: Transport mechanisms and runtime features the tool supports.

http_proxy.description: Tool supports HTTP forward proxy (CONNECT) transport.

mcp_stdio.description: Tool supports MCP stdio proxy transport.

mcp_http.description: Tool supports MCP streamable HTTP transport.

tls_interception.description: Tool supports TLS interception for CONNECT tunnel response scanning.

url_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in URL components.

request_body_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in HTTP request bodies.

header_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in HTTP headers.

response_prompt_injection_scanning.description: Tool detects prompt injection in fetched or intercepted response content.

mcp_input_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in MCP tool-call arguments.

mcp_input_prompt_injection_scanning.description: Tool detects prompt injection in MCP tool-call arguments.

mcp_tool_policy.description: Tool enforces policy on MCP tool names or action identities.

mcp_tool_result_prompt_injection_scannin.description: Tool detects prompt injection in MCP tool results.

mcp_tool_poison_scanning.description: Tool detects poisoned MCP tool definitions or descriptions.

mcp_tool_baseline.description: Tool maintains MCP tool definition baselines for rug-pull detection.

mcp_chain_memory.description: Tool tracks tool call sequences for single-session chain detection.

mcp_cross_server_chain_memory.description: Tool tracks MCP call sequences across servers for chain detection.

mcp_data_class_labels.description: Tool tracks or enforces MCP data classification labels.

a2a_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in A2A messages.

a2a_prompt_injection_scanning.description: Tool detects prompt injection in A2A messages.

a2a_card_prompt_injection_scanning.description: Tool detects prompt injection or poisoned instructions in A2A Agent Cards.

a2a_card_drift_scanning.description: Tool detects A2A Agent Card drift or rug-pull changes.

a2a_ssrf_scanning.description: Tool detects SSRF-capable URLs or file URIs in A2A messages or Agent Cards.

websocket_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects secrets and credential material in WebSocket frame payloads.

websocket_prompt_injection_scanning.description: Tool detects prompt injection in WebSocket frame payloads.

ssrf_scanning.description: Tool detects direct SSRF attempts in URL requests.

ssrf_bypass_scanning.description: Tool detects SSRF bypass encodings and alternate IP forms.

domain_blocklist.description: Tool can block benchmark-configured known-bad domains.

entropy_scanning.description: Tool detects high-entropy strings used for exfiltration.

encoding_evasion_scanning.description: Tool decodes or normalizes encoded payloads before detection.

shell_analysis.description: Tool detects obfuscated shell commands in tool arguments.

crypto_dlp_scanning.description: Tool detects cryptocurrency, financial, or wallet secret material.

hostname_exfil_scanning.description: Tool detects exfiltration encoded into DNS hostnames or labels.

dns_rebinding_fixture.description: Runner provides controlled DNS for rebinding tests.

budget_enforcement.description: Tool can enforce per-subject MCP tool-call count budgets during a run.

receipt_evidence.description: Optional declaration telling the runner where the tool emits structured receipt evidence and how to invoke the tool's own offline verifier. If omitted, receipt_produced and receipt_independently_verifiable remain no for every receipt-profile row.

evidence_dir.description: Directory containing evidence files. Relative paths are resolved relative to the tool-profile JSON file.

file_glob.description: Glob for evidence files inside evidence_dir, for example evidence-*.jsonl.

jsonl_record_type.description: Optional top-level type value to select records from JSONL evidence files, for example action_receipt. Empty string means every JSONL row is considered.

detail_json_pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the receipt detail object or JSON-encoded detail string within each JSONL row.

detail_encoding.description: How to decode the value at detail_json_pointer.

record_case_id_json_pointer.description: Optional JSON Pointer, relative to the decoded detail object, that carries the benchmark case_id for exact correlation.

record_identifier_json_pointer.description: JSON Pointer, relative to the decoded detail object, that carries the action identifier to correlate with the case, usually the action target URL. Required unless record_case_id_json_pointer is declared.

case_identifier_json_pointer.description: JSON Pointer, relative to the case object, that carries the expected action identifier, for example /payload/url. Required unless record_case_id_json_pointer is declared.

verify_command.description: Command argv used to verify an evidence file. The runner replaces {evidence_file} with the selected evidence file path and expands environment variables.

verify_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for each verifier invocation. Optional; omitted or 0 means the runner default of 10 seconds.

valid_exit_codes.description: Verifier exit codes that mean the evidence file is independently valid.

partial_exit_codes.description: Optional verifier exit codes that mean internal consistency only, producing receipt_independently_verifiable=partial.
